text.description_html:
MNG 889, Modern Brickell Cabinet Pull

The Stainless Steel Brickell Cabinet Pull is a modern handle that comes with all the perks of sleek design. The first of these is a desirable modern look that will update any kitchen. The second being ease of care. The Modern Brickell Cabinet Pull comes in a durable satin stainless finish. The Brickell Stainless Steel Pull comes packaged with the mounting hardware.

Specifications and Features of the MNG Brickell Collection:

  • Base Material: Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screws and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screws.

Available in 4 Lengths:

    MNG 88901
    • Length c.c. (center to center): 3-3/4"
    • Overall Length: 4"
    • Projection: 1-3/8"
    • Width: 3/4"

    MNG 88902
    • Length c.c. (center to center): 5"
    • Overall Length: 5-1/2"
    • Projection: 1-3/8"
    • Width: 3/4"

    MNG 88903
    • Length c.c. (center to center): 6-1/4"
    • Overall Length: 6-1/2"
    • Projection: 1-3/8"
    • Width: 3/4"

    MNG 88904
    • Length c.c. (center to center): 7-1/2"
    • Overall Length: 8"
    • Projection: 1-3/8"
    • Width: 3/4"
